prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1005; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Sugar Land, Texas, when the car behind me hit my rear bumper hard enough to push my vehicle forward into the intersection. My head snapped back and then forward, and I struck the steering wheel before the airbag deployed. I felt dizzy, had a ringing in my ears, and had a headache that grew worse over the next hour. A paramedic checked me at the scene, and I was later diagnosed with a concussion. I have been a named driver on this policy for several years, and I am providing this account as the policyholder involved. When I have been asked about the crash since then, I have added a few small details I had not recalled at first, such as the color of the other car and the weather, but the core of what happened has stayed the same each time I have described it.
